_notice: Real, sourced Kenyan administrative data (see 'sources' below). Not a development fixture.

dataset_version.description: 47 counties, 290 constituencies, 1450 wards, 301 sub-counties: IEBC 2012 delimitation, KNBS 2009/2019 census, OCHA COD-AB, via the kenya-regions aggregation.

sources.name: kenya-regions
sources.methodology: Aggregates and cross-checks primary sources: IEBC county/constituency/ward hierarchy (1450-row listing), OCHA COD-AB admin1/admin2, KNBS 2009 and 2019 census, Constitution of Kenya 2010 Articles 97/98/177. See its data/sources/README.md for per-file provenance and documented cross-source conflicts.
sources.notes: Kenya Data has not yet independently re-verified every value against the IEBC/KNBS primaries directly -- treat as secondary pending that review. validation_status is deliberately 'under_review', not 'validated'.
